confidence_notes: Food, coffee and beer anchors come from web-search results summarising Numbeo's Lisbon city page (Nov 2026: inexpensive meal ~EUR 15, mid-range meal for two ~EUR 55, draft beer ~EUR 3.00, cappuccino ~EUR 2.72) and local price guides. Numbeo's wider Lisbon-district pages run lower. Cocktail (guides: ~EUR 6-12) and wine glass (~EUR 2-4 house wine, EUR 5-12 in wine bars) are looser, so I sanity-checked them against the beer price (cocktail ~3x, glass ~1.4x). Euro prices were converted at an assumed ~1.16 USD/EUR that I did not search. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July high season from general knowledge, not live booking pages or listings, and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lisbon-specific price data was used for food and drink. Accommodation was set by comparison with other Southern European capital-city tourist markets such as Madrid and Barcelona (general knowledge, not searched), with July treated as high season.
